capabilities: Open the current file in Cursor, VSCode, or Kiro via separate commands
Jump to the current cursor position in the opened IDE
Assign per-IDE hotkeys through Obsidian's hotkey settings
Configure the executable command or path for each IDE
Test IDE availability and toggle notifications or debug mode
extras: README is bilingual (English and Chinese); no default hotkey is set to avoid conflicts with existing user configurations.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand the current file, at the current scroll/cursor position, to an external IDE for editing.
